rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for molten rock that has erupted from a volcano.

example.english: When the volcano erupted, lava flowed down the slope.
example.traditional: 火山爆發嗰陣，熔岩沿住山坡流落嚟。
example.jyutping: fo2 saan1 baau3 faat3 go2 zan6 jung4 ngaam4 jyun4 zyu6 saan1 bo1 lau4 lok6 lai4
